A truly empty string is rejected earlier, at the API's own input validation (LeadIn requires min_length=1) - this case exists to prove the *business logic* (agent/graph.py's prefilter, which strips whitespace before measuring length) catches the 'technically not empty, but still nothing there' case that validation alone can't.
